title: Chase outage: 19 November post does not retract the software-bug explanation
what_changed: The record said Chase's 19 November post said third-party providers were targeted and retracted the software-bug statement. The post as quoted by KTEN says vendors were hit by a cyber attack that reached marketing data and that it has no connection to the earlier service disruption; it does not retract the 16 November explanation. Only KTEN's own headline and lede link the two.
